title: User Research Intern
description:
**About the Role** 



* We are looking for a passionate and detail\-oriented User Research Intern to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for understanding user needs, behaviours, and motivations through various research methods. Your insights will guide business decisions.



  





**The charter for this role will include:** 



* Conduct user research using methods such as interviews, surveys, and usability testing to gather valuable insights into user needs and behaviors.
* Analyze gathered data to identify trends and patterns in user behaviors, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Business, and Product teams to integrate user insights into the user funnel and optimize product strategies.
* Advocate for the user by presenting research findings to stakeholders and ensuring that user\-centric decisions are made at every stage of product development.
* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in user research to continuously improve research methodologies and processes.



  





**Ideal Persona would:** 



* Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Behavioral Science, Psychology, Sociology, or a related field.
* Proficient in a variety of research methods and tools (e.g., usability testing software, survey tools).
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively present research findings to stakeholders.

**Company Description** 
 LinenGrass is building the operating system for hotel linen in India by supplying, laundering, tracking, and managing linen so hotel teams can focus on guest experience. The company delivers fresh, hotel\-grade linen daily, supported by real\-time RFID tracking, optimized logistics, and a simple monthly billing model with no capital expenditure for hotels. LinenGrass currently serves 100\+ hotels and 3,400\+ rooms in Bengaluru, processing over 200,000 linen items every month through multiple wash hubs with high on\-time delivery and low shrinkage rates. With a client retention rate of 98\.4% and partnerships with leading hotel brands such as Ramada, Holiday Inn, Hilton, and Sheraton Grand, LinenGrass offers a reliable, technology\-enabled service environment. Team members join a growing company focused on operational excellence, hospitality, and innovation in supply chain and service design.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The User Research Intern is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru. This role involves planning and conducting user research with hotel stakeholders and internal teams to understand workflows, pain points, and opportunities for improving LinenGrass’s services and tools. The intern will support the design and execution of interviews, surveys, and observations, synthesize findings into clear insights, and contribute to service design decisions, product refinements, and process improvements. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include collaborating with product, operations, and technology teams, preparing research materials, documenting results, and presenting key learnings in an accessible format. The role offers hands\-on exposure to hospitality operations, service design, and data\-driven decision\-making in a fast\-growing, technology\-enabled service company.

* Strong foundation in user\-centered practices, including User Research and Human Computer Interaction, with the ability to translate findings into actionable recommendations.

 HDFC Securities is one of the leading financial services companies in India, providing a wide range of investment and trading services. With a strong presence in both the B2B and B2C sectors, HDFC Securities caters to millions of users through its various digital platforms and applications.

title: Sr. UX Research & Usability Professional8
description:
**Job Requirements**  

Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? At Siemens Healthineers, we pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere.


We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone and grow both personally and professionally. Sound interesting?


Then come and join our global Design and User Experience Community as a **Sr. UX Research \& Usability Professional (UXR)** to generate actionable user insights, evaluate usability, and inform evidence\-based design decisions, driving design excellence and fostering the continuous evolution of digital healthcare solutions.


As part of our team, you will work on next\-generation healthcare solutions for healthcare professionals, patients, and customers. Supported by a collaborative global UX community, you will partner with cross\-functional teams to create impactful digital experiences and improve healthcare outcomes through the power of human\-centred design.

**Please upload your portfolio with your application.**

**Your tasks and responsibilities:**


As a **Senior User Research \& Usability Professional** , you will play a key role in shaping end\-to\-end healthcare experiences across digital solutions, products, and platforms, helping healthcare professionals work more efficiently and effectively.


In this role, you will be responsible for working across all stages of UX research and usability evaluation: identifying, planning, driving, conducting, analysing, and reporting research insights, while building an in depth understanding of users within the context of the business and product portfolio.

* Work closely with cross functional teams (UX, Product, Engineering, Clinical, Quality, Regulatory, and Business) to identify and evaluate research topics and clearly communicate research findings that increase empathy, inform decisions, and meet product evaluation criteria for usability, safety, and effectiveness.
* Conduct UX research and usability evaluation activities to inform requirements, evaluate concepts, and assess the usefulness and usability of products and services at formative and summative stages.
* Create and execute usability evaluation plans in compliance with the Quality Management System (QMS) and applicable standards, aligning usability activities with project and business objectives.
* Apply a wide range of qualitative and quantitative research methods (e.g., generative research, task based usability testing, surveys, benchmarking) to understand and validate user needs, balancing business, technical, and regulatory requirements, and conducting research both in person and remotely.
* Contribute to risk management oriented usability evaluation, including identifying use related risks and supporting mitigation strategies, to help ensure patient safety and regulatory compliance.
* Responsible for producing clear, audit ready usability documentation, including research plans, protocols, study reports, and traceability of findings to design decisions and risk controls.
* Represent user needs throughout the product development lifecycle, ensuring user insights are reflected in product direction and strategic decision\-making.
* Contribute to a strong UX culture by championing design quality, fostering collaboration, and driving the continuous improvement of healthcare experiences across our global design organization.

  

**Work Experience**  

**Your qualifications and experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Factors, Cognitive Psychology, Social Sciences, HCI, Computer Science, Usability Engineering, or a related field focused on human behavior.
* 7\+ years of professional experience in UX research and usability evaluation/engineering. Experience in the medical technology or healthcare domain is strongly preferred.
* Proven expertise in Usability Evaluation and a thorough understanding of IEC standards (e.g., IEC 62366\) and human factors principles.
* Hands\-on experience with medical device development, FDA clearance/approval processes, and/or regulated product documentation. Demonstrated ability to plan, conduct, and formally document formative and summative usability studies
* Proven experience collaborating with product, design, engineering, and regulatory teams to translate research findings into product requirements, design improvements, and usability risk mitigations.

**Your attributes and skills**

* A user\-centered mindset with deep expertise in usability, human factors, and user centered design applied to complex healthcare systems.
* Proven ability to plan, conduct, and synthesize usability research, translating insights into actionable design and risk mitigation recommendations.
* Strong understanding of healthcare workflows, clinical contexts, and patient safety considerations, with hands on experience working within regulated environments and the ability to produce clear, audit ready documentation.
* Comfort working in cross functional and multidisciplinary environments, with a detail oriented and methodical approach that balances rigor with pragmatism in fast moving product teams.

**Your Mindset**

* Forward\-thinking and quality\-driven mindset: A forward thinking UX research and usability practitioner who drives evidence based decision making through close collaboration. You position usability as a critical input to product quality and safety. You anticipate usability risks and advocate for user needs with clear, data backed rationale in cross functional discussions
* Collaborative ownership mindset: You demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and initiative in problem solving, confidently aligning UX and usability strategies with business goals. You balance user needs with business realities to drive impactful, innovative solutions. You are self directed, proactive, and capable of owning usability activities end to end, while fostering a collaborative and accountable team culture
* Continuous learning mindset: You actively seek learning opportunities and continuously expand your skills. Curious and adaptive, you stay up to date with emerging UX, usability, and healthcare trends, using new insights to enhance both personal effectiveness and the value you bring to the team and business.


To gain a deeper understanding of the products and services related to this role, please explore these links and visit our company website for more details. https://www.siemens\-healthineers.com/products\-services

**Our global team:**


We are a team of 66,000 highly dedicated employees across more than 70 countries passionately pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in healthcare to help improve people’s lives around the world. As a leader in the industry, we aspire to create better outcomes and experiences for patients no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio, spanning from in\-vitro and in\-vivo diagnostics to image\-guided therapy and innovative cancer care, is crucial for clinical decision\-making and treatment pathways.

**Our culture:**


We are part of an incredible community of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, to improve people’s lives around the world. We embrace a culture of inclusivity in which the power and potential of every individual can be unleashed. We spark ideas that lead to positive impact and continued success. Check our Careers Site


As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.


We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open.
